back: Many unsaturated monomers join by opening their C=C bonds to give one long saturated chain and no other product.
The smallest part of a polymer chain that repeats; for an addition polymer, the two former C=C carbons with their side groups and a continuation bond at each end.
nCH₂=CHCH₃ → (–CH₂–CH(CH₃)–)ₙ; CH₃ is a side group, not part of the chain.
Split the all-carbon backbone into two-carbon units with the same side groups; put a C=C between the two carbons.
LDPE: branched chains, very high pressure, radical initiator; soft and flexible. HDPE: few branches, Ziegler-Natta catalyst, low pressure; chains pack closely, dense and rigid.
Strong, non-polar C–C and C–H bonds and no hydrolysable groups: non-biodegradable.
Releases HCl (acidic, toxic) as well as CO₂; incomplete combustion can give toxic chlorinated compounds.
An addition polymer has the same empirical formula (and percentage composition) as its monomer.
